newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 17.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 17.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- French president Jacques Chirac has finished talks with Prime Minister Gyula Horn.

- Environmentalist group Duna Kor said the Hungarian cabinet is in an andvanced stage of secret talks with Slovakia about the building of a hydroelectric power station on the Danube in the Esztergom (north Hungary) region.
- Horn said the government is not having any secret talks with Slovakia and denied rumours of an agreement.
- The interest coordination council continues to debate the size of the 1997 private sector wage increase with the cabinet.
